$comment: Provenance for the run records in this directory, and the binding that makes it checkable. A conformance result is a statement about an implementation under test, so it has to name which implementation produced it; the record files carry only the outcome, and the two revision-2 records are otherwise indistinguishable. checkerSourceDigest is a deterministic hash of Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and src/**, computed by scripts/checker_digest.py, rather than a commit SHA, which cannot name the commit that carries it. reportSha256 binds this file to the records, and scripts/validate-index.py checks the whole thing in CI so a swapped report or drifted metadata fails rather than passing quietly. Reading this file is required to learn which checker produced a record: the records do not carry it themselves.

records.note: Blind first run: no vector-driven fixes.
The unchanged revision-1 build against revision 2. This is the revision boundary; the six diverging vectors are named in the record.
Regenerated and compared against a fresh run by CI on every push. Its checkerSourceDigest is recomputed from the working tree and must match.
